## Deploy

Pick an instance, then deploy in one click from the AWS console or run the AWS CLI command. Both deploy in `us-east-1`; not every instance type is available in every region. The endpoint is ready after 10 to 30 minutes. To deploy from Python, see [Deploy a model](./deploy-a-recipe).

This model is gated: accept its license on the [model page](https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct), then pass a Hugging Face [access token](https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens) as **HuggingFaceToken** (`HF_TOKEN` in the commands below).

## Send requests

The endpoint serves the OpenAI chat completions API. Any OpenAI client works with a short-lived SageMaker token:

```python
from openai import OpenAI
from sagemaker.core.token_generator import generate_token

region, endpoint = "us-east-1", "meta-llama-3-8b-instruct-g6e-xlarge"
client = OpenAI(
    base_url=f"https://runtime.sagemaker.{region}.amazonaws.com/endpoints/{endpoint}/openai/v1",
    api_key=generate_token(region=region),
)
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "What is the capital of France?"}],
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
```

## Clean up

Endpoints are billed per hour while they run. Delete the stack when you are done, from the CloudFormation console or with:

```bash
aws cloudformation delete-stack --region us-east-1 --stack-name meta-llama-3-8b-instruct-g6e-xlarge
```
